iTifhSV3YPdPp3P4VQcmgg.zh: 非洲地區疫情持續,WHO今年9/16發佈風險評估報告,該地區風險評估為中等(Moderate)、全球風險低(Low)。今年截至8月下旬,該洲共8國出現疫情,累計逾1.5萬例疑病例,以奈及利亞12,155例疑病例、225例死亡為主,其次為查德(1,251例疑病例、5例死亡)、日(818例疑病例、27例死亡)及幾內亞(600例確定病例、49例死亡)等。疫苗覆蓋率下降、低實驗室確診率、即時治療(抗生素及白喉抗毒素)的不穩定性,人群跨境移動等因素阻礙疫情控制。
iTifhSV3YPdPp3P4VQcmgg.en: Diphtheria activity continues in Africa. WHO issued a risk assessment on 16 September: the regional risk is assessed as moderate and the global risk as low. As of late August this year, eight countries in the region have reported outbreaks, with more than 15,000 cumulative suspected cases, mainly Nigeria with 12,155 suspected cases and 225 deaths, followed by Chad (1,251 suspected cases, 5 deaths), Niger (818 suspected cases, 27 deaths) and Guinea (600 confirmed cases, 49 deaths). Declining vaccine coverage, low laboratory confirmation rates, unstable access to immediate treatment (antibiotics and diphtheria antitoxin) and cross-border population movement are hindering outbreak control.

KDRlz3r4l1zdeaPiasgEbw.zh: 非洲區自2025年初迄今年3/1,阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞和南非8國共通報超過29,000 例疑病例,其中1,420例死亡(CFR:4.9%),其中 752例經實驗確定病例,主要集中於日(313例)、奈及利亞(211例)及南非(93例)。WHO評估疫情有進一步地理擴散的潛力、致死率偏高、控制疫情的資源(疫苗與DAT)嚴重不足、且監測與實驗室系統受限, 該區傳播風險為中,全球風險為低。 奈及利亞日(Niger)州疫情呈多點擴散,今年截至8月,累計報告124例確定病例,17例死亡(CFR:13.7%),高於該國同期平均(2.3%),病例主要為未接種疫苗之兒童。因疫苗覆蓋率低,以及跨區人口流動及疫苗猶豫等因素,該國刻正推動逐戶接種疫苗及與宗教領袖合作等措施,以防止疫情擴散。 塞內加爾今年5至8月進行病歷回溯調查(醫療機構病歷),有591 例曾出現喉嚨痛、扁桃腺炎等症狀,其中7例為確定病例,主要集中於東部凱杜古(Kedougou)及薩拉亞(Saraya)地區,該國已於受影響區加強疫苗補接種與主動監測,以防止疫情向周邊擴散。
KDRlz3r4l1zdeaPiasgEbw.en: From early 2025 to 1 March this year, eight countries in the African Region (Algeria, Chad, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria and South Africa) reported more than 29,000 suspected cases, of which 1,420 died (CFR 4.9%). 752 cases were laboratory-confirmed, mainly in Niger (313), Nigeria (211) and South Africa (93). WHO assesses that the outbreak has potential for further geographic spread and a high case fatality rate, that control resources (vaccines and diphtheria antitoxin, DAT) are severely insufficient, and that surveillance and laboratory systems are limited; the transmission risk in the region is moderate, and the global risk is low. In Niger State, Nigeria, the outbreak has spread across multiple points: as of August this year, 124 confirmed cases and 17 deaths had been cumulatively reported (CFR 13.7%), higher than the country's average for the same period (2.3%); most cases were unvaccinated children. Owing to low vaccine coverage, cross-regional population movement and vaccine hesitancy, the country is pursuing door-to-door vaccination and cooperation with religious leaders to prevent further spread. In Senegal, a retrospective review of medical records from May to August this year identified 591 cases with symptoms such as sore throat and tonsillitis, of which 7 were confirmed, mainly in the eastern Kédougou and Saraya areas. Senegal has strengthened catch-up vaccination and active surveillance in affected areas to prevent spread to surrounding areas.

jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年5/31累計144國/地區報告18萬5,882例確定病例,其中509例死亡。 今年5月共計32國家/地區報告1,142例確定病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加(649例)、中國(89例)、法國(63例)、澳洲(50例)及德國(45例)為高,63.9%的病例來自非洲地區。相較今年4月,西太平洋區及非洲區病例數呈上升趨勢 ,其餘地區疫情則下降,挪威通報首例Ib型病例,另波蘭先前的I型病例確定為Ib型次分支。 非洲地區近6週(5/4-6/14)共計10國報告790例確定病例,其中3 例死亡(CFR 0.45%),以馬達加斯加、肯亞、幾內亞、南蘇丹、喀麥隆及剛果⺠主共和國為高;非洲以外地區,為西班牙與泰國持續報告Ib型社區傳播。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月以來面臨全球最大規模的Ib型疫情,截至今年6/14,累計2,117例確定病例與7例死亡(多為免疫低下者)。疫情已擴及全國60%的行政區(69/115),主要影響15-49 歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(超過7.9萬人施打),惟面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流與醫療量能挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。
jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 31 May this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 185,882 confirmed cases, including 509 deaths. In May this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.3%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (649), China (89), France (63), Australia (50) and Germany (45), and 63.9% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with April this year, case numbers rose in the Western Pacific and African Regions and declined in other regions. Norway reported its first clade Ib case, and Poland's earlier clade I case has been identified as a clade Ib sub-lineage. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (4 May–14 June), 10 countries reported 790 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.45%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar, Kenya, Guinea, South Sudan, Cameroon and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Outside Africa, Spain and Thailand continued to report clade Ib community transmission. Madagascar has faced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 14 June this year, 2,117 confirmed cases and 7 deaths (mostly among immunocompromised people) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 60% of the country's administrative areas (69 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15 to 49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has been rolled out (more than 79,000 people vaccinated), the outbreak remains uncontrolled because of challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics and health system capacity.

TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022 年截至今年4/30 累計144 國/地區報告18 萬4,531例確診病例,其中,至少506例死亡。 非洲地區近6週(4/6-5/17)通報確診病例數最高國家:馬達加斯加(780例)、幾內亞(40例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、肯亞(27例)、賴比瑞亞(17例)。 全球近6週(4/6-5/17)共有19個國家報告 Ib型病毒:   社區傳播共15國:馬達加斯加(780例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、巴基斯坦(29例)、肯亞(27例)、西班牙(18例)、德國(17例)、瑞士(14例)、葛摩/葡萄牙(6例)、斯洛伐克/剛果共和國(4例)、哥倫比亞(3例)、泰國/丹麥(2例)。 與旅遊相關(境外移入)共4 國:美國(5 例)、模里西斯(2 例)、臺灣/愛爾蘭(1例)。
TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 30 April this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 184,531 confirmed cases, of which at least 506 were fatal. In Africa, the countries reporting the most confirmed cases over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May) were Madagascar (780), Guinea (40), South Sudan (37), the DRC (35), Kenya (27) and Liberia (17). Globally, 19 countries have reported clade Ib virus over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May). Community transmission has been reported in 15 countries: Madagascar (780), South Sudan (37), DRC (35), Pakistan (29), Kenya (27), Spain (18), Germany (17), Switzerland (14), Comoros/Portugal (6), Slovakia/Republic of the Congo (4), Colombia (3), and Thailand/Denmark (2). Travel-associated (imported) cases have been reported in four countries: United States (5), Mauritius (2), and Taiwan/Ireland (1).

qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年3/31累計144國/地區報告18萬2,945例確診病例,其中,至少503例死亡。 今年3月共計48國家/地區報告1,235 例新增確診病例,其中5例死亡(CFR 0.4%),70.4%的病例來自非洲地區,相較今年2月,東地中海及西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降,哥倫比亞、丹麥、厄瓜多和新加坡通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/3/9-4/19)共計16國通報969例確診病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、肯亞、蒲隆地為高;非洲以外地區,阿根廷、丹麥、德國、巴基斯坦、葡萄牙、新加坡、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 巴基斯坦信德省通報一起院內群聚事件(前已掌握),傳播原因主要為共用保溫箱、氧氣設備及設備表面受污染。在3至4月期間,該省9縣(/30縣)共29例確診與8例死亡(CFR 28%),死亡個案均為6個月以下嬰兒,基因定序確認為Ib型變異株。
qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 31 March this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 182,945 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 503 died. In March this year, 48 countries and territories reported 1,235 new confirmed cases, including five deaths (CFR 0.4%). 70.4% of cases came from the African region. Compared with February, cases rose in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions and fell in other regions. Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador and Singapore reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African region, over the past six weeks (9 March–19 April), 16 countries reported 969 confirmed cases, including three deaths (CFR 0.3%), with the highest numbers in Madagascar, the DRC, Guinea, Kenya and Burundi. Outside Africa, Argentina, Denmark, Germany, Pakistan, Portugal, Singapore, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to show clade Ib community transmission. Sindh Province in Pakistan reported a hospital cluster (already known), with transmission mainly attributed to shared incubators and oxygen equipment and contaminated equipment surfaces. In March and April, the province's nine of 30 districts recorded 29 confirmed cases and eight deaths (CFR 28%). All deaths were in infants under six months, and genetic sequencing confirmed a clade Ib variant.

SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今(2026)年1/31累計144國/地區報告17萬9千餘例確診病例,其中,至少483例死亡。 今年1月共計50國家/地區報告1,334 例新增確診病例,其中3例死亡,66%來自非洲地區,相較去年12月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,葛摩及法屬留旺島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/1/5-2/15)共計20國通報1,142例確診病例,其中4例死亡,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞及迦納為高;非洲以外地區,法國、葡萄牙及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 WHO 於 2 月發布全球快速風險評估,性接觸仍是跨國擴散主因,全球傳播風險評估為中,對MSM群體(尤其未固定性伴侶族群)傳播風險為中,對一般民眾傳播風險為低。 全球目前累計報告2例Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之重組病毒株,分別為於英國報告具東南亞旅遊史,以及印度報告具阿拉伯半島國家旅遊史之病患,基因定序顯示其為相同重組病毒株。WHO表示實際病例數可能多於目前通報數,惟重組病毒株臨床症狀與一般分支相,且皆無重症,接觸者追蹤亦未發現續發病例,評估整體風險維持不變。
SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.en: Monthly update: since 2022 and up to 31 January this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 179,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 483 died. In January this year, 50 countries and regions reported 1,334 new confirmed cases, including 3 deaths; 66% came from the African Region. Compared with December last year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined. Case numbers are declining in all regions globally. Comoros and Réunion reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (5 January–15 February 2026), 20 countries reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; the highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia and Ghana. Outside Africa, France, Portugal and Spain have continued to report clade Ib community transmission. WHO issued a global rapid risk assessment in February: sexual contact remains the main driver of cross-border spread. The global transmission risk is assessed as moderate; the risk for MSM populations, especially those with non-stable sexual partners, is moderate, and the risk for the general public is low. Globally, two recombinant viruses carrying Ib and IIb gene segments have been reported cumulatively: one in a patient in the United Kingdom with a Southeast Asia travel history, and one in a patient in India with a travel history to Arabian Peninsula countries. Genetic sequencing shows they are the same recombinant strain. WHO notes that actual case numbers may be higher than reported, but the clinical symptoms of the recombinant virus are consistent with ordinary lineages, none have been severe, and contact tracing has found no secondary cases; the overall risk assessment remains unchanged.

nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至去(2025)年12/31累計143國/地區報告17萬7千餘例確診病例,其中,至少477例死亡;去年累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中215例死亡。WHO 去年12月共計42國家/地區報告1,169 例新增確診病例,其中 6例死亡,69%來自非洲地區,相較11月,全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,捷克、以色列、馬達加斯加、泊爾及法屬馬約特島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2025/12/7-2026/1/18)共計15 國通報871例確診病例,5例死亡,其中,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞、肯亞及迦納為高。馬達加斯加自去年12月起爆發Ib型社區傳播,首例為近期無旅遊史個案,已迅速擴散至全國。 非洲以外地區,法國、義大利及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播;捷克通報1例病例仍在調查中。 WHO發布《Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus》,彙整現有證據與專家意見,說明執行 MPXV 基因體監測的之關鍵考量,以支持病原體基因體學於公共衛生監測及應變之應用。WHO 1/22
nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 31 December 2025, 143 countries and areas have reported more than 177,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 477 deaths. In 2025, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 215 deaths (WHO). In December 2025, 42 countries and areas reported 1,169 new confirmed cases, including 6 deaths; 69% came from the African Region. Compared with November, cases declined in all regions. Czechia, Israel, Madagascar, Nepal and Mayotte (France) reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the six weeks from 7 December 2025 to 18 January 2026, 15 countries reported 871 confirmed cases and 5 deaths, with the highest numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia, Kenya and Ghana. Madagascar has had community transmission of clade Ib since December 2025, beginning with a case without recent travel history, and it has spread rapidly nationwide. Outside Africa, France, Italy and Spain continue to report community transmission of clade Ib; Czechia has one case still under investigation. WHO published Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus, which compiles existing evidence and expert opinion on key considerations for MPXV genomic surveillance, to support the use of pathogen genomics in public health surveillance and response (WHO, 22 January).

R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/30累計142國/地區報告17萬5千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%);今年截至11/30累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中206例死亡(CFR:0.41%)。 今年11月共計48國家/地區報告2,150 例新增確診病例,其中 5例死亡(CFR:0.27%),68%來自非洲地區,相較10月,歐洲區與西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。 非洲地區近6週(11/2–12/14)共計19 國通報1,435例確診病例,其中7 例死亡(CFR:0.5%),其中以剛果民主共和國(427例)、幾內亞(330例)、賴比瑞亞(176例)、肯亞(142例)及迦納(107例)為高,除賴比瑞亞外,其餘近期病例數呈下降趨勢,另剛果民主共和國多省同時流行Ia及Ib型,部分省分受安全情勢與人口流動影響監測能力,病例數有低估情形。 非洲以外地區,羅馬亞通報首例 Ib 型境外移入病例,病患為成年男性,於今年8月確診,曾至中國且具高風險行為,入境後即住院隔離,境內未發現接觸者,後續亦無通報病例;西班牙及荷蘭持續出現Ib型社區傳播;英國12/2通報1例境外移入病例,同時檢出Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之 MPXV 重組病毒株,病況為輕症,現階段對該重組病毒株之流行範圍仍缺乏足夠資訊。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源缺乏,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,惟對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 30 November 2025, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 175,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 467 deaths (CFR: 0.27%). In 2025 up to 30 November, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 206 deaths (CFR: 0.41%). In November 2025, 48 countries and areas reported 2,150 new confirmed cases, including 5 deaths (CFR: 0.27%); 68% came from the African Region. Compared with October, cases rose in the European and Western Pacific Regions and declined in other regions. In the African Region, over the past six weeks (2 November–14 December), 19 countries reported 1,435 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR: 0.5%). The highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (427), Guinea (330), Liberia (176), Kenya (142) and Ghana (107). Except for Liberia, recent case numbers have declined in these countries. In the DRC, multiple provinces are experiencing clade Ia and Ib simultaneously, and in some provinces surveillance capacity is affected by security conditions and population movement, so cases may be underestimated. Outside Africa, Romania reported its first imported clade Ib case, in an adult male diagnosed in August this year who had travelled to China and had high-risk behaviour. He was hospitalised in isolation on arrival, no contacts were identified domestically, and no further cases have been reported. Spain and the Netherlands continue to report clade Ib community transmission. On 2 December, the United Kingdom reported 1 imported case, in which a recombinant MPXV strain containing gene segments of both clade Ib and clade IIb was detected. The case was mild, and there is currently insufficient information on the spread of this recombinant strain. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are lacking, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because asymptomatic infections and cases among travellers to affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The risk to the general public is assessed as low, but as moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), particularly those with non-fixed sexual partners. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete epidemiological investigation and contact tracing, and high-risk people are urged to get vaccinated.

bInLbkRMVDE04eWMXcEvBA.zh: WHO非洲區共計8國(阿爾及利亞、查德、幾內亞、馬利、茅利塔亞、日、奈及利亞、南非)累計報告逾2萬例疑病例,其中9,864 例經實驗室確診,1,252例死亡,多數病患為兒童及青少年族群。受限於診斷試劑/檢驗/臨床照護能力不足及白喉抗毒素(DAT)供應短缺等因素,嚴重影響疫情防治工作。WHO考量非洲區疫情可能持續擴散,評估非洲區整體公共衛生風險為高,另非洲區以外多數國家具備完善之免疫計畫與健全之監測系統,全球公共衛生風險為低。
bInLbkRMVDE04eWMXcEvBA.en: Eight countries in the WHO African Region (Algeria, Chad, Guinea, Mali, Mauritania, Niger, Nigeria and South Africa) have cumulatively reported more than 20,000 suspected cases, of which 9,864 were laboratory-confirmed and 1,252 died. Most patients are children and adolescents. Insufficient diagnostic reagents, testing and clinical care capacity, and shortages of diphtheria antitoxin (DAT) are seriously hindering outbreak prevention and control. WHO considers that the outbreak in the African Region may continue to spread, and assesses the overall public health risk in the African Region as high. Most countries outside the African Region have well-established immunization programmes and sound surveillance systems, so the global public health risk is low.

8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年迄今已累計25國通報逾95,345例病例(29,493例確診),其中582例死亡(CFR:0.61%),烏干達、幾內亞及迦納疫情上升,烏干達今年截至8/10已累計6,466例確診病例,其中41例死亡;莫三比克自今年7月爆發疫情,截至8/7累計170例疑病例,其中29例確診,迄無死亡案例,該國鄰近馬拉威、南非、尚比亞及辛巴威,跨境風險增加;獅子山疫情更新,該國今年截至8/11累計5,115例確診病例,疫情趨緩。
8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.en: Mpox outbreaks continue in Africa. So far this year, 25 countries have reported more than 95,345 cases (29,493 confirmed), of which 582 died (CFR: 0.61%). Outbreaks are rising in Uganda, Guinea and Ghana. Uganda had cumulatively reported 6,466 confirmed cases as of 10 August this year, of which 41 died. Mozambique's outbreak began in July this year; as of 7 August, 170 suspected cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 29 were confirmed, and no deaths have been reported so far. The country borders Malawi, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe, increasing cross-border risk. Sierra Leone's outbreak update: 5,115 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 11 August, and the outbreak is easing.

7qHy8qJpcsJZ3_vaW_-e3w.zh: 非洲疫情更新,獅子山今年截至8/4報告5,072例確診病例,其中47例死亡,多集中於西部城市與農村地區,單週(29週)報告逾200例;迦納今年截至7/31報告302例確診病例,於7/22-30新增45例,另於7/27報告首例死亡案例;幾內亞疫情上升,今年截至7/26報告381例確診病例,其中1例死亡,男性占約7成,新增3區有報告病例。
7qHy8qJpcsJZ3_vaW_-e3w.en: In Africa, Sierra Leone had reported 5,072 confirmed cases as of 4 August this year, of which 47 died. Cases are concentrated in western urban and rural areas, with more than 200 cases in week 29 alone. Ghana reported 302 confirmed cases as of 31 July this year, with 45 new cases between 22 and 30 July, and reported its first death on 27 July. Guinea's outbreak is rising: 381 confirmed cases had been reported as of 26 July this year, including one death; men account for about 70%, and three new districts have reported cases.

axYehbXxXPw7Wm4knSP1bA.zh: 甘比亞宣布爆發疫情,7/22報告首例,病患為26歲女性,來自該國西部第1衛生區,18日確診,感染源及分支不明;鄰近該國之幾內亞於近期爆發疫情,幾內亞今年截至7/25已累計206例病例,新增1例死亡;獅子山疫情更新,今年截至7/13已累計逾4,700例病例,其中35例死亡。
axYehbXxXPw7Wm4knSP1bA.en: The Gambia has announced an outbreak. The first case was reported on 22 July: a 26-year-old woman from the first health region in the western part of the country, diagnosed on 18 July. The source of infection and clade are unknown. Neighboring Guinea has also recently had an outbreak; as of 25 July this year, Guinea has cumulatively reported 206 cases, with 1 new death. Sierra Leone's update: as of 13 July this year, more than 4,700 cumulative cases have been reported, including 35 deaths.

wLm9jAzzgico6Uz1xj81rg.zh: 中國自6月底截至7月7日新增9例Ib型病例,其中4例為前已掌握之家庭群聚感染事件,為2例無症狀兒童及2例具接觸史及症狀之成人;另3例與國際旅遊者具流病關聯,其中1例具確診病例之性接觸史;1例為無旅遊史,但與未確診但具症狀者有接觸史,具體細節仍在調查中。該國自去年12月截至今年7月初已累計23例Ib型病例,由於該國調查未明,傳播風險判定為未知。 幾內亞疫情上升,7月初單週報告約50例病例,今年截至7/10累計112例確診病例,其中1例死亡,病例為IIb型,分布於該國首都柯那克里與其周邊區域,指標病例具獅子山旅遊史,因該國南接之獅子山及賴比瑞亞皆有疫情,跨境風險增加,當局加強監測與邊境管制措施。 土耳其回溯報告2024年10月1例Ia型病例,具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,並無二次傳播。
wLm9jAzzgico6Uz1xj81rg.en: China reported 9 new clade Ib cases from the end of June to 7 July. Four were from household cluster infections already identified: two asymptomatic children and two adults with contact history and symptoms. Three were linked to international travelers, one of whom had sexual contact with a confirmed case. One had no travel history but had contact with an unconfirmed person who had symptoms. Details are under investigation. From last December to early July this year, China has reported 23 cumulative clade Ib cases. Because the investigation is incomplete, transmission risk is classified as unknown. Guinea's outbreak is rising: about 50 cases were reported in the first week of July, and 112 confirmed cases have been reported this year as of 10 July, including 1 death. The cases are clade IIb, distributed in the capital, Conakry, and surrounding areas. The index case had travel history to Sierra Leone. Sierra Leone and Liberia, to Guinea's south, both have outbreaks, so cross-border risk has increased, and authorities have strengthened surveillance and border controls. Turkey retrospectively reported one clade Ia case in October 2024, with travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and no secondary transmission.

EI5QxRqKcDs6rsULpOMpTg.zh: 幾內亞南部恩澤雷科雷區今年截至6/1報告2例,其中1例死亡,相關疫情調查及接觸者追蹤作業進行中。
EI5QxRqKcDs6rsULpOMpTg.en: In the Nzérékoré region of southern Guinea, 2 cases had been reported as of 1 June this year, one of which was fatal. Investigation and contact tracing are ongoing.

kY4peGDHORIBotL0ZEMU2w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/1-5/7期間, cVDPV2型新增查德1例,cVDPV3新增幾內亞1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增阿富汗7件,cVDPV2陽性樣本新增3國共3件,分別為喀麥隆、中非共和國、吉布地各1件。
kY4peGDHORIBotL0ZEMU2w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 1 April and 7 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 1 in Chad, and cVDPV3 cases by 1 in Guinea. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 7 in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 3 across 3 countries: 1 each in Cameroon, the Central African Republic and Djibouti.

xy7lWioReq0doO0YEjOHRw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/13-19期間,WPV1型新增報告2國3例,分別為巴基斯坦2例、阿富汗1例;cVDPV2型新增報告阿爾及利亞1例病例;cVDPV3型新增報告幾內亞1例病例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦/阿富汗各9件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本,新增巴勒斯坦3件、阿爾及利亞1件。
xy7lWioReq0doO0YEjOHRw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 13 and 19 February, WPV1 cases were newly reported in 2 countries: 3 cases, 2 in Pakistan and 1 in Afghanistan. One new cVDPV2 case was reported in Algeria, and one new cVDPV3 case in Guinea. For environmental samples, 9 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in each of Pakistan and Afghanistan. For cVDPV2-positive samples, 3 new samples were reported in Palestine and 1 in Algeria.

lO1cQsJ0DiSyPSpchV5bgQ.zh: 非洲疫情持續,自2024年初截至49週累計3國共10,747例病例,其中1,157例確診,197例死亡,分別是奈及利亞10,450例病例,184例死亡、賴比瑞亞270例病例(11例死亡)及幾內亞27例病例(6例死亡),WHO評估傳播風險為高。
lO1cQsJ0DiSyPSpchV5bgQ.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. From early 2024 to week 49, three countries cumulatively reported 10,747 cases, including 1,157 confirmed and 197 deaths: Nigeria 10,450 cases and 184 deaths, Liberia 270 cases (11 deaths), and Guinea 27 cases (6 deaths). WHO assesses the transmission risk as high.

AdEEOhlIAriIvuJj5XJKmw.zh: 非洲疫情更新,2024年截至11/30累計1,138例病例,其中41例確診,7例死亡,病例分布於剛果 (452例)、中非共和國(390例)、加彭(146例)、南蘇丹(139例)、喀麥隆(8例)、幾內亞(2例)及烏干達(1例)。
AdEEOhlIAriIvuJj5XJKmw.en: Africa epidemic update: As of 30 November 2024, 1,138 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 41 confirmed and 7 deaths. Cases were distributed as follows: Republic of the Congo (452), Central African Republic (390), Gabon (146), South Sudan (139), Cameroon (8), Guinea (2) and Uganda (1).

5JET1-MQR8PkZ4pqzwAFag.zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至12/16累計3國報告10,747例病例,其中1,157例確診,197例死亡(CFR:17%),以奈及利亞報告10,450例、184例死亡最為嚴峻,另有賴比瑞亞及幾內亞分別報告270例(11例死亡)及27例(2例死亡),疫情持續流行中。
5JET1-MQR8PkZ4pqzwAFag.en: Africa epidemic update: As of 16 December 2024, three countries had reported 10,747 cases cumulatively, including 1,157 confirmed and 197 deaths (CFR 17%). Nigeria, with 10,450 cases and 184 deaths, is the most severely affected; Liberia reported 270 cases (11 deaths) and Guinea 27 cases (2 deaths). The outbreak continues.

38KIHrf_aTeVI-3q2saAzQ.zh: 非洲今年截至11/22累計報告23,040例病例,其中11,114例確診,588例死亡(CFR:5.26%),以奈及利亞報告16,747例(461例死亡)最為嚴峻,另有幾內亞報告2,869例、查德2,625例、日746例、茅利塔亞及加彭各數十例亦正處流行期,其中,查德近期疫情明顯上升;非洲區去年報告2.7萬例病例。 越南北部高平省11月新增1例死亡病例,病患為11歲女孩,於11月中旬出現咳嗽及發燒症狀,一週後死亡,當局已進行接觸者隔離及校園消毒。
38KIHrf_aTeVI-3q2saAzQ.en: Africa reported 23,040 cases cumulatively this year as of 22 November, including 11,114 confirmed and 588 deaths (CFR 5.26%). Nigeria has the most severe situation, with 16,747 cases (461 deaths). Guinea reported 2,869 cases, Chad 2,625 and Niger 746, while Mauritania and Gabon each reported several dozen cases; all are in epidemic periods. Chad's recent outbreak has risen markedly. The African Region reported 27,000 cases last year. Viet Nam: In November, Cao Bằng Province in northern Viet Nam reported one new death, an 11-year-old girl who developed cough and fever in mid-November and died a week later. Authorities have quarantined contacts and disinfected the school.

sFK2182pyl_vb2-LFexvqQ.zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至11/15累計3國報告10,267例病例,其中1,110例確診,188例死亡(CFR:16.9%),以奈及利亞報告10,028例、175例死亡最為嚴峻,另有賴比瑞亞及幾內亞分別報告212例(11例死亡)及27例(2例死亡),疫情持續流行中。
sFK2182pyl_vb2-LFexvqQ.en: Africa update: As of 15 November this year, 3 countries have cumulatively reported 10,267 cases, including 1,110 confirmed cases and 188 deaths (CFR: 16.9%). Nigeria is the most severely affected, with 10,028 cases and 175 deaths. Liberia and Guinea reported 212 cases (11 deaths) and 27 cases (2 deaths), respectively. The outbreak remains active.

yfYSgiBBBmPA7Ey6MbHpyA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 10/24-10/30期間,巴基斯坦新增2例WPV1病例;查德新增2例cVDPV2病例;幾內亞新增3例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分,阿富汗新增1件WPV1陽性樣本;共4國新增4件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為喀麥隆/幾內亞/日/塞內加爾各1件。 西班牙於10/3報告該國首件cVDPV2陽性樣本,該樣本於9月中旬自該國東北部加泰隆亞廢水樣本中檢出,當地迄無報告病例,當地疫苗覆蓋率逾92%,評估對公眾健康影響有限。 法屬圭亞那於10/14首次檢出cVDPV3陽性樣本,樣本採集自首府開雲(Cayenne),目前尚無報告病例。
yfYSgiBBBmPA7Ey6MbHpyA.en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 24 and 30 October, Pakistan added 2 WPV1 cases, Chad added 2 cVDPV2 cases and Guinea added 3 cVDPV3 cases. For environmental samples, Afghanistan added 1 WPV1-positive sample; a total of 4 countries added 4 cVDPV2-positive samples, one each in Cameroon, Guinea, Niger and Senegal.

Spain reported on 3 October its first cVDPV2-positive sample, detected in mid-September in wastewater from Catalonia in northeastern Spain. No cases have been reported locally, local vaccination coverage exceeds 92%, and the impact on public health is assessed as limited.

French Guiana detected its first cVDPV3-positive sample on 14 October. The sample was collected in the capital, Cayenne. No cases have been reported so far.

3S2aQDaVh5BvsnutA2kgKg.zh: 哥倫比亞中西部托利馬省10/29報告1例死亡病例,為47歲男性個案,當局已採取相關防治措施。 幾內亞中北部拉貝大區11/2報告2例病例,分別為15、24歲女性個案,其中1例為孕婦,皆於9月中旬出現症狀,10/5採檢送驗,10/8確診;非洲截至10/26累計703例病例,6例死亡。
3S2aQDaVh5BvsnutA2kgKg.en:
Colombia: In Tolima Department in west-central Colombia, 1 death was reported on 29 October, in a 47-year-old man. Authorities have adopted relevant prevention and control measures.

Guinea: In Labé Region in north-central Guinea, 2 cases were reported on 2 November, a 15-year-old and a 24-year-old woman; one of them was pregnant. Both developed symptoms in mid-September, were sampled on 5 October and confirmed on 8 October. Africa has cumulatively reported 703 cases and 6 deaths as of 26 October.

X217ZeJzLS3fNRwjRQXYmQ.zh: 非洲今年截至10/11累計報告19,130例病例,其中9,816例確診,494例死亡(CFR:5.0%),以奈及利亞報告14,195例(397例死亡)最為嚴峻,另有幾內亞報告2,869例、查德1,307例、日746例及加彭13例亦正流行中;該地區去年報告2.7萬例病例,CFR:5.7%。
X217ZeJzLS3fNRwjRQXYmQ.en: Africa has cumulatively reported 19,130 cases so far this year as of 11 October, including 9,816 confirmed cases and 494 deaths (CFR: 5.0%). Nigeria is the most severely affected, with 14,195 cases (397 deaths). Guinea reported 2,869 cases, Chad 1,307, Niger 746 and Gabon 13, and these outbreaks are also ongoing. Last year the region reported 27,000 cases, with a CFR of 5.7%.

QgRX45jh5pJZfg3qgxYRoQ.zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至10/18累計3國報告9,829例病例,其中1,075例確診,186例死亡(CFR:17.3%),以奈及利亞報告9,604例、174例死亡最為嚴峻,另有賴比瑞亞及幾內亞分別報告198例(10例死亡)及27例(2例死亡),疫情持續流行中,其中賴比瑞亞近期疫情有上升趨勢。 美國愛荷華州10/28公布新增1例死亡病例,研判係自西非移入,當局已加強監測密切接觸者;該國近55年內累計報告8例病例,均具旅遊史,多數症狀輕微。
QgRX45jh5pJZfg3qgxYRoQ.en:
Africa update: As of 18 October this year, 3 countries have cumulatively reported 9,829 cases, including 1,075 confirmed cases and 186 deaths (CFR: 17.3%). Nigeria is the most severely affected, with 9,604 cases and 174 deaths. Liberia and Guinea reported 198 cases (10 deaths) and 27 cases (2 deaths), respectively. The outbreak continues, and the recent outbreak in Liberia shows an upward trend.

United States update: On 28 October, Iowa announced 1 new fatal case, presumed to have been imported from West Africa, and authorities have strengthened monitoring of close contacts. Over the past 55 years, the country has cumulatively reported 8 cases, all with travel history, and most with mild symptoms.
